note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented customers and billing records, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "cancel-flow-dunning-planner" skill. Here is our Stripe export for the last six months, our cancel offer log and screenshots of how cancelling works today. Where are we losing subscribers, and what should the cancel flow and the failed-payment emails look like?

business.name: Example Booking Software
business.what_it_sells: online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers
business.customers: small service businesses; many owners sign up with a personal card

answers_from_owner.where_customers_are: US (including California), UK, Canada, Germany and Australia; customers are businesses, but many sole traders sign up like consumers

screens: Cancel page: '30% off for 3 months' offer shown to everyone, with 'Contact support to cancel' below it
Support form: reason dropdown and a message box; support confirms the cancellation by email
current_cancel_flow.offer: 30% off for 3 months, shown to everyone

current_dunning.retries: Stripe Smart Retries over 14 days, then the subscription is cancelled
emails: Klaviyo flow 'Payment failed reminder': one email on day 0 linking to /app/settings/billing/ (login required)
